description.zh: 通知策略的名称， 支持模糊匹配。
description.en: The name of the notification policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh:
- `false`（默认）：通知策略为内部系统创建。
- `true`：通知策略为外部系统创建。
> 外部系统创建的通知策略不支持在ARMS控制台修改通知策略的分派条件。
description.en:
*   The type of notification policies to be queried. Valid values: `false` (default): notification policies created in Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS).
*   `true`: notification policies created in an external system.

>  You cannot use the ARMS console to modify the dispatch rules of a notification policy that is created in an external system.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-dispatch-rule --name Prod --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --system true --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListDispatchRule --region cn-hangzhou --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --System true --Name Prod
